correctness.rationale: The normalizing scalar h^{-alpha}(3/2)^alpha is positive. Direct Taylor differentiation gives the coefficients 1..6; Q4 and Q5 are positive completed squares, r5 is between zero and one and r6>3/4 from the beta-polynomial inequality. The exact recurrence 3(j+1)c_{j+1}=4(j-alpha)c_j+(2alpha-j+1)c_{j-1} traps ratios (3/4,1) inductively for all j>=6, proving infinite-index claims. Independent symbolic calculations and seven rational alpha cases through j=121 confirmed all displayed signs and ratios. Numerical enumeration is auxiliary.
